## What's new

- **Covers chosen for you.** Settings > Covers can give folders without a cover the best of their screenshots: one person ahead of two, two ahead of three, filling as much of the picture as possible. Black frames, intros, title cards and credits are left out, and a cover you chose yourself is never replaced. Choose a model there (Fast, Balanced or Most accurate), and it's downloaded once and runs on your PC. Your screenshots never leave it.
- **Pick from the best matches.** Right-click a folder and choose **Choose a cover for me...** to see up to 12 of its best screenshots, best first. Pick one, or press **Surprise me**. The cover is exactly the screenshot you choose.
- **One filter bar everywhere.** Folders, Scenes and Downloads now share the same bar: search, sort with a direction button, Filters, Views, the number shown and the tile size, which is always in the same place.
- **See what's filtering the list.** Each filter in use shows as a chip you can remove with one click, with Clear all beside them. The rest of the filters open in a panel over the tiles, so nothing moves.
- **Views.** Save a search, sort, filters and tile size under a name, now for folders as well as scenes. The ready-made lists (5-star scenes, 4K rated 4 or more, added in the last 30 days, largest folders) are in the same menu.

## Changes

- **Scenes** can be filtered to played or not played, and by date added in the last 7 days, 30 days, 6 months or a year, or a custom range.
- **Downloads** filters as you type, with no Apply button, and has a length range. Its tiles are now the same shape as everywhere else, so they no longer look much bigger.
- **Demo mode** shows a pill in the title bar.
- **Shortcuts:** Ctrl+F to search, Ctrl+Shift+F for the filters, Esc to close them.
- "HDD label" is now "Drive" in the filters.

## Fixes

- Downloads could show an empty list the first time it was opened, until Refresh.
